prompts.orbit:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production background for the corporation base panorama in the existing Void Dominion space strategy game. It will be BEHIND separately rendered frontal building sprites and interactive UI. Generate ONE finished flat full-bleed panoramic landscape illustration, not a mockup or contact sheet.
Composition/framing: very wide landscape, exact 20:9 aspect ratio (target 2400 by 1080). Straight level camera, near-orthographic distant environment. Horizon and BACK EDGE OF THE EMPTY GROUND PLATFORM at precisely 61.1 percent of image height (y=660 of 1080). The bottom 38.9 percent is one broad uninterrupted flat horizontal buildable deck seen in restrained perspective. Deck extends off the image on left/right/bottom; no raised side walls, no edge at the bottom, no gap in its middle. Perspective panel seams subtle and converge near x50%,y46%. Reserve all three building placement zones: central x34%-66%,y29%-80%; left x12%-38%,y52%-89%; right x62%-89%,y50%-90%. No objects or raised geometry in these zones: only background sky and flat deck; buildings will cover them. Keep upper central sky calm enough for buildings' silhouette and small UI. Strong distant celestial composition with clean readable large shapes; details concentrated in far sky and far left/right edges. This is a real atmospheric painted world, NOT a wireframe, grid hologram or abstract gradient.
Style/medium: polished realistic science fiction game environment matte painting, restrained painterly texture, precise believable metal materials, dark cinematic atmosphere, same practical futuristic aesthetic as gray frontal industrial base building sprites. Sharp at game scale, no excessive tiny noise. Subdued illumination, clear gentle atmospheric depth, lower deck moderately dark neutral graphite with a little colored reflected light so pale building sprites remain distinct.
Constraints: empty buildable environment ONLY. No buildings, towers, hangars, ships, people, creatures, vehicles, debris piles, weapons, logos, lettering, numbers, watermarks, interface, drawn footprint circles, landing pad numbers or diagram grid. No baked-in building shadows. No near foreground objects. No transparency.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet orbital construction platform high above a blue habitable planet. Sweeping enormous planet limb rises through the LEFT HALF of the sky, with slate-blue oceans, soft pearl cloud swirls, a thin luminous cyan atmosphere; deep ink-blue space above and across the right, a few crisp stars, one tiny distant moon high to the right. The curvature and atmospheric depth should feel immense without flooding the image with light. EMPTY steel platform starts along the straight horizontal y61.1% line, with graphite panel plates, sparse recessed teal running lights only along its distant edge and far margins. Palette midnight navy, desaturated blue, steel-gray, restrained turquoise, cloud white accents.
